ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Engineering Parallel Software. Prerequisites: ECE 391 or CS 241. Explores the evolution of programming languages as an engineering process and examines the challenges that face the hardware and software industries with increasing numbers of processors on a chip. Using C++ as a focal point, examines the expression and implementation of abstractions such as access control, inheritance, templates, and exception handling, identifying both the advantages and the potential pitfalls of these tools. Provides hands-on experience with tools and techniques through programming assignments. Describes challenges posed by parallelism, attempts to address those challenges, and why proposed solutions have not been adopted by the broader industry.
